name: tapestry
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: memory that keeps the right things in mind. Recalls what bears on each prompt with honest match labels, remembers the conversation, and keeps each project's memories in their own namespace.

judge.title: Who checks your memories for conflicts
judge.description: In the background, after a session ends, a model can check whether memories that sit close together contradict each other. auto: nothing is sent unless a Jev key is set below. claude: memories are sent to Claude (Haiku) through the Claude Code login you already use. jev: they are sent to TypeSafe's Jev model through the Vercel AI Gateway with the key below, with no zero-data-retention flag. none: memories never leave your machine.

jev_key.title: Vercel AI Gateway key for Jev
jev_key.description: Only used if Jev is the judge, or if the choice above is auto. Needs paid gateway credits.
